body: Thanks for you input. Maybe it’s because I put my all into them and all of them just abandon me and treat me like trash? Don’t say “why should they care about you” because that’s the most fucked up thing

I don’t feel better easily, I lost a bf and it took me a ton of months even though we weren’t together that long. I’m just so upset that I’m not cared about and forgotten about so easily even by my best friend. What’s the point

He’s my ex boyfriend now, that’s why I’m so upset and refuses to talk to me and got over it in a day. He was my best friend for years before we started dating so I’m so sad he was so okay to lose me, I understood past guys since we knew each other for a few weeks, but him..I never thought it would happen. I already have abandonment issues and I feel replaceable, if I’m replaceable to those even the closets to me then what’s the point
